row.title: One tenant's missing credential stopped every tenant's redeploy
row.body: tenant-repos.yml exited on the first tenant it could not create (replication-ledger, no ORG_ADMIN_TOKEN/LANE_PAT/lane App in this repo) and the redeploy step had no if, so moved tenants such as Unlearn were never redeployed by it. Now each tenant failure is recorded and skipped, the run still fails at the end, and the redeploy step runs unless cancelled.

title: One tenant's missing credential stopped every tenant's redeploy
